title: Seating, Onboard Comfort and Cabin Upgrade Terms of the Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
What a fare brand includes at the seat and in the cabin, and what it charges where it includes nothing, is scheduled below for all seven Air Ticket Fare Brands.

## Seating and boarding

| Fare brand | Standard seat included | Standard seat (USD per traveller per segment) | Extra-legroom seat (USD per traveller per segment) | Priority boarding included | Priority boarding (USD per traveller per segment) | Seat map released (hours before departure) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | no | 22.00 | 79.00 | no | 19.00 | 24 |
| Economy Saver | no | 18.00 | 69.00 | no | 15.00 | 24 |
| Economy Classic | yes | 0.00 | 59.00 | no | 15.00 | 48 |
| Economy Flex | yes | 0.00 | 49.00 | yes | 0.00 | 48 |
| Premium Economy Select | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 | yes | 0.00 | 72 |
| Business Saver | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 | yes | 0.00 | 96 |
| Business Flex | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 | yes | 0.00 | 96 |

## Onboard inclusions and the upgrade

| Fare brand | Lounge access | Hot meal | Wifi voucher | Upgrade permitted | Upgrade co-payment (USD per traveller per segment) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | no | no | no | no | 0.00 |
| Economy Saver | no | no | no | no | 0.00 |
| Economy Classic | no | no | no | yes | 350.00 |
| Economy Flex | no | yes | no | yes | 300.00 |
| Premium Economy Select | no | yes | yes | yes | 250.00 |
| Business Saver | yes | yes | yes | yes | 150.00 |
| Business Flex | yes | yes | yes | yes | 100.00 |

## Reading the two tables

The seat-map release point is the number of hours before departure at which the remaining seat map is released; it is scheduled at 24 hours on the two cheapest brands, 48 on Economy Classic and Economy Flex, 72 on Premium Economy Select and 96 on the two Business brands.

The two brands scheduled without an upgrade are also the two scheduled with an upgrade co-payment of 0.00 USD; that figure records the absence of the product rather than a free one. Where the upgrade is scheduled as permitted, the co-payment falls as the brand rises, from 350.00 USD on Economy Classic to 100.00 USD on Business Flex.

A standard seat and an extra-legroom seat are scheduled as separate products: Economy Classic and Economy Flex include the first at 0.00 USD while still pricing the second at 59.00 USD and 49.00 USD.

## Hypothetical figures

A hypothetical party of two travelling Economy Flex over two segments and wishing for extra legroom throughout would meet the extra-legroom rate of 49.00 USD four times over, since the rate is scheduled per traveller per segment; the same party in Premium Economy Select would meet a rate of 0.00 USD.
